The Toolkit

Reading helps on a good day. On a bad one you need something that does a job. These are built for the bad ones.

No account and no sign-up. Everything you enter stays in this browser on this device. Clearing your browser data clears it.

  1. Sober CounterDays, money not spent, and what your body is doing at each milestone.→
  2. Urge SurfA timer for the moment a craving hits. Ride it out, then move.→
  3. Daily Check-InThirty seconds a day. Hungry, angry, lonely, tired, mood, cravings.→
  4. Crew CardThree people, your warning signs, what works. A plan for hard nights.→
